W265 human web pages reuse the W248 Pod profile lease and request context. ChatGPT starts at ChatGPTTap.homeURL; Dots starts at ChatGPTDotsState.url. They are normal human sibling browsers. Neither receives the TAP script. The existing native Dots path is still used when web Space is disabled.

The first visible ChatGPTWebSpacePane takes the Pod's human surface owner UUID. It holds that owner while switching ChatGPT/Dots. Another pane keeps its Tap visibility lease and displays `ChatGPT 已在另一個視窗顯示`. It cannot move either browser. After the owner disappears, the waiting pane takes ownership and mounts the same page. A native container must detach before that page can mount again. The pane releases its visibility lease on disappearance; the Pod closes its root plus both human siblings before returning the profile lease.

All four Duo forms use the same pane. ChatGPT in tent uses the normal phone top bar and web pane; other tent content keeps the existing video route. Web Space disabled keeps native DM ChatGPT, including its drawer and temporary-chat control. While web Space is enabled, native conversation shortcuts pass through to CEF.

`w265dmchatgpt` reuses the W248 isolated CEF app harness. It serves only loopback fake pages, uses Chromium's mock keychain, and reports viewport metrics from those pages. It clicks the real glass controls, types drafts through native CEF input, verifies both pages retain their documents/drafts/URLs across all forms, tests both opening orders plus ownership transfer, and captures ChatGPT/Dots × fable5/aurora × light/dark. Real chatgpt.com and real accounts remain user acceptance.

The selected segment uses the existing chip's foreground color for its rim and exposes the selected accessibility trait. The test reads the actual SwiftUI segment frames, then sends native mouse events; it never invokes the button's action directly. When testing closure, it removes the SwiftUI root before closing the harness window, matching the production DM roots' presentation flags. ClickRig otherwise retains its hosting view after window closure.
